ext_desc.message: A Chrome extension that changes the layout of Google search results to be center-aligned.

settings_desc.message: A Chrome extension that changes the layout of Google search results to be center-aligned.

settings_desc2.message: On this page, you can set the base screen width (px) and edit custom CSS. Use the tabs below to configure settings shared by all tabs, or settings that apply to a single Google search tab only.

screen_width_help.message:
Center-aligned styles will be applied when the screen width is greater than or equal to this value.
This value is used by every search tab that does not define its own.
(Default: 1280px)

tab_screen_width_help.message:
Uncheck "Use common setting" to apply a different screen width to this search tab only.
While it is checked, the common setting is used.

common_css_help.message: Click the save button to apply the entered CSS to every Google search tab.

tab_css_help.message:
Click the save button to apply the entered CSS to this Google search tab only.
When the specificity is the same as the shared styles for all tabs, these rules take precedence.

per_tab_layer_label.message: Applied to one search tab only

reset_confirmation_message.message: Do you want to reset the custom CSS of the tab you are editing to its previous state?
